name: Jehohanan
overview: Jehohanan was a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Bebai. He is noted specifically for having married a foreign wife, a detail recorded in Ezra 10:28. There is no additional information regarding his tribe or other distinguishing notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Jehohanan means 'YHWH has been gracious,' reflecting a theophoric Hebrew name that acknowledges God's grace. This name is a proper name and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jehohanan as a descendant of Bebai, establishing a family connection through lineage. Beyond this, no further family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jehohanan's significance lies in his inclusion among those who had married foreign wives, a situation addressed in the post-exilic community's efforts to maintain covenantal purity as seen in Ezra 10:28. His mention highlights the challenges faced by Israel in restoring faithfulness to God's commands after the exile, underscoring the importance of obedience and holiness in the community.
